data.name: Razzak
data.gender_notes: Razzak is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'Razzaq' which means 'The Provider' or 'The Sustainer'. It is a name given to those who are generous and kind, always striving to provide for themselves and others. The name Razzak carries the meaning “The Provider” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Razzak usually hope their child will grow to embody the provider and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies the provider of sustenance and blessings. It is a reminder to be generous and kind, to always strive to provide for ourselves and others, and to be grateful for the blessings bestowed upon us.
data.etymology: Razzak belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Provider.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Razzak total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: رزاق
in_arabic.meaning: الرزاق اسم الله الحسنى، يقدم الرزق للخلق
in_arabic.long_meaning: الرزاق هو من أسماء الله الحسنى، ويعني الذي يقدم الرزق للخلق، ويكفله لهم، ويضمنه لهم. مشتق من الرزق، وهو الإطعام والكفاية. ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم في سورة الحج آية ٥٨: 'وَمَا مِن دَابَّةٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ إِلَّا عَلَى اللَّهِ رِزْقُهَا'

in_urdu.name: رزاق
in_urdu.meaning: رزاق اللہ کے خوبصورت ناموں میں سے ایک ہے، جو مخلوقات کو رزق فراہم کرتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: رزاق اللہ کے اسماء الحسنی کا ایک حصہ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے رزق مہیا کرنے والا۔ یہ نام عربی روٹ ر-ز-ق سے ماخوذ ہے، جو کفایت اور فراہمی کے مفہوم کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ قرآن مجید میں الحج سورہ کی 58 آیت میں ذکر ہوا ہے: 'وَمَا مِن دَابَّةٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ إِلَّا عَلَى اللَّهِ رِزْقُهَا'

in_hindi.name: रज़्ज़ाक
in_hindi.meaning: रज़्ज़ाक अल्लाह के सुंदर नामों में से एक है, जो रचना को रिज़्क प्रदान करता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: रज़्ज़ाक अल्लाह के अस्मा-उल-हुसना का एक हिस्सा है, जिसका अर्थ है रिज़्क देने वाला। यह नाम अरबी मूल र-ज़-ق से लिया गया है, जो पर्याप्तता और प्रावधान की भावना को दर्शाता है। कुरआन में यह नाम सूरतुल-हज आयत 58 में वर्णित है: 'وَمَا مِن دَابَّةٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ إِلَّا عَلَى اللَّهِ رِزْقُهَا'

in_pashto.name: رزاق
in_pashto.meaning: رزاق د الله ښکلي نومونو څخه يو دی، کوم چې رزق ورکوي
in_pashto.long_meaning: رزاق د الله تعالي ښکلي نومونو څخه يو دی، چې د رزق ورکولو معنی لري. دا نوم د عربي ريښي ر-ز-ق څخه اخيستل شوی دی، کوم چې د کفايت او تامين احساس څرګندوي. په قرآن کريم کې يې الحج سوره کې 58 آيت کې يادونه شوې ده: 'وَمَا مِن دَابَّةٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ إِلَّا عَلَى اللَّهِ رِزْقُهَا'

in_english.name: Razzak
in_english.meaning: Razzak means Provider, one who gives sustenance
in_english.long_meaning: Razzak is one of the beautiful names of Allah, meaning the Provider or the Sustainer. Etymologically derived from the Arabic root ر-ز-ق (r-z-q), which conveys the sense of providing sustenance or nourishment. Mentioned in the Quran, Surah Al-Hajj, verse 58: 'And there is no creature on earth but that its provision is with Allah'

pronunciation.urdu: اردو میں تلفظ کی تفصیل: رزّاق
pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل: رزاق

data.cultural_impact: The name Razzak carries an important cultural significance in Islamic societies, where generosity and kindness are highly valued traits. It is a reminder to those who bear this name to always strive to provide for their families, communities, and the needy. It also encourages them to be charitable and considerate towards others, as they are seen as representatives of Allah, the ultimate Provider and Sustainer.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Razzak also carries deep meaning as it reflects the concept of Allah as the Provider, the One who sustains all of His creation. By carrying this name, individuals are constantly reminded of their dependence on Allah and their role in His plan. It is a call to honor the divine gift of life and to use one's abilities and resources to serve others, reflecting the Prophet Muhammad's teachings of "the strong is not the one who overpowers the people, but the strong is the one who controls himself in the face of anger." (Bukhari). Thus, the name Razzak serves as a spiritual reminder of the importance of generosity, kindness, and self-control in leading a meaningful and purposeful life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Razzak: The One Who Provides Sustenance. A reminder of Allah's boundless generosity, granting us every need in this life and the next.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Razzak, a renowned Persian warrior and poet, was a senior commander in the army of the founder of the Mongol Empire, Genghis Khan. He is said to have converted to Islam before his death around 1240 AD.

Another Razzak, a prominent figure in the Deccan Sultanate of the Bahmani Dynasty in the late 15th century, is known for his military conquests and patronage of arts and sciences. He ruled from 1482 to 1510 AD.
